query:
Who made the argument that natural Beaujolais wine is currently being overlooked by drinkers in the UK, and what in their phrasing correctly identifies them as the source?

Options:
A. Felix
B. Marcus
C. Kezia
D. Dom
context:
[1] (about=Marcus, episodic, t2 @2025-09-08T19:09:00) Honestly, the thing is, the natural wine people in this country still sleep on Beaujolais. Some of the best skin-contact work in France is happening there right now and everyone's still chasing Burgundy or the trendy Jura stuff. I want to open something from that region on Sunday.
[2] (about=Felix, episodic, t4 @2025-09-15T19:13:00) The Lapierre was a good choice. The lamb and the wine worked well together. The orange from Georgia was less predictable than expected, in a positive sense.
[3] (about=Marcus, episodic, t2 @2025-09-08T19:18:00) 2pm is perfect. Wine I've got sorted. If anyone wants to bring flowers or something for the table that would be nice but genuinely not required. Just yourselves.
[4] (about=Marcus, episodic, t2 @2025-09-08T19:13:00) Felix I do have the Lapierre, actually. Good call. The cellar stays cool. I was also thinking an orange from Georgia to start, something aromatic and almost savoury, it pairs beautifully with the squash.
[5] (about=Dom, episodic, t2 @2025-09-08T19:10:00) Increased my volume this week, legs and conditioning both, it's intense tbh. Body's going to need the calories Sunday 😂 happy with whatever wine, red preferably.
[6] (about=Felix, episodic, t8 @2025-09-29T19:24:00) One assumes this is about dairy.
[7] (about=Felix, episodic, t2 @2025-09-08T19:11:00) I would suggest the 2022 Lapierre Beaujolais if you have it, Marcus. That producer has been consistent for five years. The question is whether you can keep it cool enough given the venue.
[8] (about=Zara, episodic, t2 @2025-09-08T19:08:00) Marcus the squash and tomatoes sound literally perfect, I'm so on board with the menu 🌿 what's the wine situation though, this is important
[9] (about=Felix, episodic, t14 @2025-10-20T19:20:00) It was tolerable. I prefer actual cheese. The tradition of this group ending the year with plans we may or may not follow through on is not a new one, is it Priya.
[10] (about=Marcus, episodic, t8 @2025-09-29T19:40:00) Honestly, the thing is Ethiopian is one of the most underrated cuisines in this city. The spice work alone. I'm in.
agent_answer:
B. Marcus.

His phrasing — “the natural wine people in this country still sleep on Beaujolais” and “I want to open something from that region on Sunday” — identifies him as the source, since he speaks in the first person about the UK wine scene and his own plan to open a Beaujolais.
